narrative: In the account book. The narrow ledger lies open on the board by one candle, the light at the window already gone, and the pen stops at a short line under church and gifts. In the account book. Sand lies in the wet of the two letters, and the candle is the only light on the page.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the two shillings by candle and left the rest uncounted.
